title: [CQ-C05] Negative search provenance
description:
Objective: Cache negative searches with namespace, exclusions and content-derived generation.

Deliverable: Negative search provenance. This is task C05 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): C04.
definitionOfDone: New/untracked/deleted helper files invalidate prior negatives.

Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.

C04 task-1b7b6067a95f4078bfb2c780c2a598e9 is BLOCKED with no plan, so there is no cache store, key or generation contract to extend, and a separate negative store would be a second cache, which the epic rail forbids.
2. DoD1 requires new, untracked or deleted helper files to invalidate prior negatives. The only landed provider (src/context/repositorySource.ts, CQ-C02) serves committed bytes only. The validated base+overlay content provenance belongs to CQ-C02b task-311dbda408864b7597852e683076ca24, which is BLOCKED.
A commit-only negative cache would make DoD1 vacuous, and enumerating the mutable worktree would violate DoD3 (watchers and status are not freshness).
This row auto-returns to PLANNING when both are DONE. Plan it then against their landed APIs: an incomplete enumeration stays unknown, and the generation moves on any added, deleted or changed byte. Neither prerequisite depends on this row, so there is no cycle. Notes are in Serena task-task-9ef257f58b7f4c4191f206f67bf3d865-handoff.
